title: novelty

setup.note: Screen heartbeats: one content-new frame, then the same frame every 10 s for two minutes, a flush, then heartbeats only.

input_events: frame A repeated every 10 s until t = 120 s
after the flush: frame A every 10 s for 15 minutes

wrong.label: heartbeat-keeps-alive
